typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER as string,
		CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_SCRUB_DATE as timestamp,
		CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_JOB_NAME as string,
		CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_DISPOSITION_CODE as string,
		CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_ASSOCIATE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER ,CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_SCRUB_DATE ,\'NME\' AS CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_JOB_NAME ,DSS.CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_DISPOSITION_CODE ,CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_ASSOCIATE FROM dbo.PDS_CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING DSS LEFT JOIN dbo.PDS_MEMBER M ON DSS.CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER = M.MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER LEFT JOIN dbo.PDS_CALLLISTMASTER CLM ON CLM.CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID = M.MEMBER_IID 			AND CLM.CALLLISTMASTER_CALLLISTDATE_IID IN  	(SELECT CALLLISTDATE_IID FROM PDS_CALLLISTDATE WHERE CALLLISTDATE_CALLLIST_IID IN  		(SELECT CALLLIST_IID FROM PDS_CALLLIST WHERE CALLLIST_CD IN 			(SELECT CONFIGURATION_VALUE FROM PDS_CONFIGURATIONS WHERE CONFIGURATION_FILTER = \'DAILY_SCRUB_LIST_NMEQM\'))  				AND CONVERT(DATE,CASE WHEN DATEPART(HOUR,CALLLISTDATE_DATE) > 20 THEN DATEADD(DAY,1,CALLLISTDATE_DATE) ELSE CALLLISTDATE_DATE END) = CONVERT(DATE,GETDATE())) WHERE DSS.CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_JOB_NAME = \'National_Mbr_Engagement_QM\' AND CALLLISTMASTER_IID IS NULL 			ORDER BY CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> FillMissingNMEfile
FillMissingNMEfile derive(CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_SCRUB_DATE_Unicode = toDate(toString(CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_SCRUB_DATE, 'MM/dd/yyyy'), "MM/dd/yyyy"),
		CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_DISPOSITION_CODE_Unicode = toString(CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_DISPOSITION_CODE),
		CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER_Unicode = toString(CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER),
		CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_ASSOCIATE_Unicode = toString(CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_ASSOCIATE),
		CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_JOB_NAME_Unicode = toString(CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_JOB_NAME)) ~> NonUnicodetoUnicodeNME
